news.title: Hexa Tradex Limited Announces Resignation of Neeraj Kanagat as CEO, Effective January 9, 2026
news.body: Hexa Tradex Limited announced that Mr. Neeraj Kanagat has stepped down from the position of Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Company, with effect from January 9, 2026, consequent upon transiting to the role within a group company of the PR Jindal Group. This transition is part of the restructuring and growth realignment of the group and has been undertaken in the interest of fostering operational synergies and driving focused execution across various businesses.

news.title: New minor risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$100m. Market cap: ₹8.94b (US$98.3m) This is considered a minor risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook.
